title: M1 Foundation Preview - durable linear self-hosting
description: Complete the transactional authority core and a Windows+Claude single-node vertical slice that can safely coordinate one low-risk moe-next task end to end. This is the cutover gate for limited self-hosting, not graph fan-out or a best-tool claim.
architectureNotes: Current main contains phase-zero evidence tooling, SQLite event/decision foundations, structural graph preview, bounded JSON ingress, a truth-presentation kernel, and a DEVELOPMENT_ONLY fairness reference. Build remaining Phase 2-4 contracts in shallow parallel tracks, then one integration/hardening gate. Multi-node activation is typed UNSUPPORTED throughout this epic. Product decision 2026-08-07: replace general agent chat with a daemon-owned typed session coordination fabric connecting coder sessions, terminal/effect wrappers, reviewers, and the control room. It carries bounded addressed REQUEST/RESPONSE/EVENT/CONTROL/HANDOFF envelopes with auth, sequence, dedupe, backpressure, expiry, and replay; free-form text is advisory and can never bypass command authority. Product decision 2026-08-07: root AGENTS.md is the canonical tool-neutral repository instruction contract; root CLAUDE.md is a minimal Claude-specific bridge and generated session prompts are never authoritative. Skills are versioned content-addressed advisory bundles selected explicitly and snapshotted into context/input/evidence manifests; skill content can never grant commands, capabilities, policy, lease, approval, or execution authority.
epicRails: Authoritative design: D:/projexts/moes/docs/plans/2026-08-05-moe-rebuild-design.md SHA-256 1D9D1EC97D3F07247FBBC088045E0BA2FD6DA8307F10A9026C55106419383191; do not edit it in implementation tasks.
Development happens only in D:/projexts/moe-next; do not create sibling Git worktrees. Runtime workspace isolation promised by the design remains in scope.
Preserve foreign work; stage and commit only explicit owned paths. Never use git add -A, implicit push, implicit merge, reset, or stash.
Fail closed with stable reason codes; missing or unverifiable evidence stays UNKNOWN and never gains authority.
Use TDD. Keep each production source focused, target <=250 lines, and split before 400 lines. No debug, probe, scratch, or generated evidence files may remain in commits.
